icon-button.$description: IconButton component tokens. Evidence: audit family F04 (107 instances, 14 variants, 14 designs; 481 of 533 icon-only buttons unlabelled). Icons are graphical objects, so their contrast target is 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11).

radius.$description: OBSERVED: translucent circles over photos and grey-outlined pills. Plain and overlay are circles.

primary-radius.$description: OBSERVED: dark blue filled icon button at 4px; matches Button primary.

color.$description: PROPOSED: the system focus ring (plain and primary).

inner.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's own focus ring, white 2px inside (box-shadow 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #1c1c1c). One of the two rings contrasts with any photo (decision 19).

outer.$description: OBSERVED: AcmeCo's own focus ring, ink #1c1c1c 2px outside.

duration.$description: LEGACY-NAMED: --legacy-cta-transition 0.15s. Code only: Figma has no motion variables (decision 15).

size.$description: OBSERVED: 32px translucent circles (60%); above the 24px minimum target (WCAG 2.5.8).

icon-size.$description: PROPOSED: icon for the small size.
PROPOSED: icon for the medium size.
OBSERVED: 24px no-container icons (the most common icon button).

icon.$description: PROPOSED: one ink colour. Absorbs the observed #000000, #333333, #4f5254, #595959, #63666a and blue #0888ba (4.0:1, fails AA).

hover.$description: PROPOSED: grey circle on hover. Not observed.

icon.$description: OBSERVED: dark icons on translucent white circles.

default.$description: OBSERVED: translucent white circles (85% kept; 60% absorbed). Ink on it stays 12.07:1 even over a black photo.

hover.$description: PROPOSED: opaque white on hover. Not observed.

icon.$description: OBSERVED: white icon on dark blue (search submit).

default.$description: OBSERVED: dark blue filled icon button.

icon.$description: PROPOSED: dark blue marks the selected state of a toggle such as save (decision 1). The icon also fills, so the state isn't colour alone (WCAG 1.4.1).

background.$description: PROPOSED: explicit grey for filled variants (decision 12).
